tables.caption: Temporins reported to have leishmanicidal activity.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Sequence and physicochemical properties of temporin-SHa and its analogs.
footnotes: a The substituted residues are indicated in bold in the sequence of the analogs.
b Theoretical average molecular mass using Peptide Mass Calculator v3.2 (http://rna.rega.kuleuven.ac.be/masspec/pepcalc.htm).
e hydrophobic moment were calculated using HeliQuest (http://heliquest.ipmc.cnrs.fr/).

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Antibacterial activity of temporin-SHa analogs compared to the parent peptide.
footnotes: a Values represent the means of three independent experiments performed in triplicate.
b MICGM denotes the geometric mean of the MIC values (indicated in bold) for all Gram-negative, Gram-positive and yeast/fungal strains.
d Resistant to methicillin and oxacillin.

e Resistant to amoxicillin/clavulanic acid, cephalothin, ciprofloxacin, erythromycin, gentamicin, imipenem, oxacillin, penicillin, tetracycline, ampicillin, doxycycline, methicillin, azithromycin, ceftriaxone, clindamycin, lincomycin, perfloxacin, rifampin, and tobramycin.

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: Antiprotozoal activity of temporin-SHa and [K3]temporin-SHa.
footnotes: a [A2,6,9]SHa and [A2,6,9, K3]SHa were inactive against L. infantum promastigotes (IC50 > 200 μM).
b values in parentheses were obtained in serum-free medium.

tables.label: Table 5
tables.caption: Cytotoxic activity of temporins SHa and analogs against human cells and rat erythrocytes.
footnotes: Values were determined with GraphPad Prism 6.0 software and are the means of three independent experiments performed in triplicate. IC50, half maximal inhibitory concentration; LC50, half maximal lytic concentration (erythrocytes and macrophages).

tables.label: Table 6
tables.caption: Therapeutic indices (T.I.) of [K3]SHa and SHaa.
footnotes: a Therapeutic indices of SHa are indicated in parentheses.

b Ratio of IC50 or LC50 values (for human cells from Table 5) over the geometric mean of MIC values (from Table 3 and corresponding to Gram-negative, Gram-positive, and yeast/fungal strains). When IC50 or LC50 values were higher than the maximum concentration tested, a minimal 2-fold concentration value was used to calculate the therapeutic index because IC50 or LC50 values were determined by carrying out serial 2-fold dilutions (for example, LC50 > 100 was considered as 200).
c Values in bold represent the fold improvement in the therapeutic index of [K3]SHa compared to SHa.
